name: Issued Books Report
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Transaction:Link/Library Transaction:180",
    member AS "Member:Link/Library Member:180",
    member_name AS "Member Name:Data:180",
    book AS "Book:Link/Book:180",
    book_name AS "Book Name:Data:200",
    issue_date AS "Issue Date:Date:120",
    due_date AS "Due Date:Date:120",
    status AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM
    `tabLibrary Transaction`
WHERE
    docstatus = 1
    AND status = 'Issued'
ORDER BY
    due_date
